investigated.tariffChannel: direct CPO ad-hoc must be separated from Enel On Your Way eMSP Pay Per Use
positiveEvidence: Official CPO page identifies Enel X Way Italia S.r.l. as CPO, >20,000 public points, and explicitly says the interactive map indicates whether a station is enabled for ad-hoc charging.
Official Enel On Your Way support/service terms allow guest charging without registration using card/prepaid card/PayPal and Pay Per Use; QR scan can start charging.

Official Enel On Your Way tariff page publishes deterministic AC/DC/HPC and time-band Pay Per Use prices for Enel/Ewiva service, but this is a service tariff offered by Enel X/Enel Energia and therefore must not automatically be equated with the CPO ad-hoc tariff for every IT*ENX EVSE.
investigated.networkWideConclusion: No safe current proof found that the published Enel On Your Way Pay Per Use grid is identical to the direct CPO ad-hoc price for every IT*ENX EVSE. Global/class-wide promotion is therefore rejected fail-closed.
investigated.blockingCondition: deterministic IT*ENX EVSE -> ad-hoc-enabled flag -> direct ad-hoc tariff mapping from the CPO map/QR/payment surface, or first-party statement explicitly equating direct ad-hoc tariff with the published Pay Per Use grid for the applicable ENX scope
